name: Polyhedral Face Classes Are Not Conditioning-Closed
statement: A nonempty coordinate conditioning of a polyhedral face class need not be a polyhedral face class.
proof: Conditioning the square face class at vertex 1 to one yields $\{\varnothing,\{2\},\{4\},\{2,3,4\}\}$. A face with vertex set $\{2,3,4\}$ requires all three singleton vertex faces, but $\{3\}$ is absent.
